summary: SoundHound AI filed an 8-K reporting receipt of the final foreign investment clearance from Bulgaria for its pending acquisition of LivePerson, Inc. The merger structure involves two sequential mergers: first Merger Sub I merging into LivePerson, then Merger Sub II merging into the surviving entity, leaving LivePerson as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. No financial terms (price per share, premium, or implied value) are disclosed. The deal remains subject to other conditions, including LivePerson stockholder approval. All required foreign investment clearances (Bulgaria, Canada, Italy, Germany, UK) have now been obtained. The risk-arb angle is the remaining shareholder vote and any potential delays.
